title: Tiny Hero Quest
description: Explore vibrant pixel dungeons as a brave miniature knight—leap pitfalls, slash slimes, and uncover hidden treasure chests.
controls: Use arrow keys / WASD (or on-screen controls) to move, jump, and swing your sword at dungeon foes.

zh-CN.title: 小小勇者大冒险
zh-CN.description: 复古像素横版冒险小小勇者：化身勇敢小骑士挥剑斩史莱姆、跨越机关陷阱探索神秘地牢宝藏！
zh-CN.controls: 使用键盘方向键/WASD（或屏幕按钮）控制小勇者移动跳跃挥剑斩怪通关。
